strategy_roster.name: Trendline Cross Alert
strategy_roster.notes: The module only monitors manually supplied horizontal and trendline levels and submits no automatic orders. An impossible negative-price guard preserves its alert-only behavior; level inputs and notifications are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Digital CCI Woodies
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is unavailable, so EMA(14)/EMA(6) preserve the documented fast/slow crossover periods and opposite exits. The short branch, CCI calculation, and six-hour resampling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Bug
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so an EMA(10)/EMA(20) direction cross is the explicit long-side proxy and the inverse cross exits. The documented 2% stop and 1% target are retained; SAR acceleration, trailing, and short mode are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Advanced EMA Cross
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,10),ema(close,30)) and adx(high,low,close,14) > 25 and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10)/EMA(30), ADX(14), and normalized ATR(14) are explicit fallbacks for the unnamed cross and trend-strength filters. SuperTrend, USD-strength sizing, minimum holding time, dynamic stops, and exact thresholds are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: HMA Crossover ATR Curvature
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(15)/EMA(34) and positive fast-average ROC proxy the documented HMA crossover and nonnegative curvature. HMA and ATR-based trailing risk are unavailable; the short branch is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: 4119 Champion
strategy_roster.notes: An RSI(14) recross from oversold with price above EMA(20) proxies the champion's pending long breakout; the opposite RSI/trend condition exits. Three stop orders, RSI level, point protection, and trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Bjorgum Double Tap
strategy_roster.notes: A break above the prior 50-bar high with an SMA(20) filter approximates a double-bottom neckline breakout. Pattern pivots, Fibonacci targets/stops, tolerance, and the short side are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: RobotPowerM5 Meta4 V12
strategy_roster.notes: Bulls Power and Bears Power are unavailable; EMA(5)/EMA(20) with positive one-bar momentum is a current-timeframe proxy. Point stops, targets, trailing, and the martingale/order controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: JK BullP AutoTrader
strategy_roster.notes: Bulls Power is unavailable, so an RSI(13) recross from oversold represents the documented buy reversal and the neutral cross exits. Point-based stop, target, trailing, and the separate sell branch are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Averaged Stoch & WPR
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic and Williams %R are unavailable; oversold RSI(26) with a rising one-bar RSI ROC is the long reversal proxy, and RSI overbought exits. The optional percentage stop has no numeric value, and the short side is omitted.
